requirements.description: User states public transport proximity is preferred. Using the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71) as the threshold for 'near' public transport.
User prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through C. Energy_score_class cannot separate C from E (it groups B-E as 3), so energy_class is used.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. This is the explicit surface requirement, so it is used as a >= filter. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied. Energy class and public transport proximity are not reference columns and were ignored.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area >= 850, a 3.0 km radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892), energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, and mobility >= 71. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the requested coordinates. The requirement on tipologia_bene_immobile was not applied: that column is in the runtime schema but not in filterable_columns (the allowlist intersection), so per the rules it was ignored. property_type is the filterable equivalent, but it was not added because it was not among the extracted requirements.
